confirmed: CV2 has an unstable useStepRouter object in effect dependencies. A browser reproduction against the original main made 1567 intercepted resume GETs and logged 30 maximum-update-depth errors in 5 seconds.
After memoizing the router, the same initialization makes 2 GETs in development Strict Mode and 1 GET in the built Preview, with no update-depth errors.
Current Production CRM_AUTH_URL is https://www.carrime.app. APP_BASE_URL still points to https://carrime.vercel.app/.
Vercel redirects carrime.app to www.carrime.app using 308, preserving /cv/1. The old carrime.vercel.app URL currently redirects to the canonical domain using 307.

Current Production sign-in accepts the canonical origin (401 INVALID_EMAIL_OR_PASSWORD for a synthetic nonexistent account), and rejects an untrusted origin (403 INVALID_ORIGIN). This does not prove successful login with a real admin account.
Production selfpr/summary/experience API probes with synthetic data returned HTTP 200. Preview browser generation returned 443 characters with upstream HTTP 200 in 11743 ms.

localStorage and host-only cookies do not migrate between the old origin and the canonical origin. Legacy storage-key fallback works only within the same origin. No storage is deleted or automatically exported.

Runtime request logs contain paired server and client events with the same correlation ID, a separate client-only network event and an independent auth-origin rejection event. Logs contain only allowlisted technical fields.
notProven: The exact failing request reported during 17:00-17:59 JST cannot be identified from the available historical logs. Lack of matching logs is not proof that no failure occurred.
The initialization loop is a confirmed independent defect. A causal link between that defect and the exact past catch alert has not been proven.

The historical INVALID_ORIGIN message proves rejection of that origin at that time. An old-base-URL configuration reproduces it in a memory-adapter integration test, but the exact historical deployment/environment snapshot has not been recovered.
A causal link between Better Auth rejection and the AI request failure has not been established. The AI routes do not call Better Auth.

changes.navigation: Memoize useStepRouter to stop repeated data loading on CV2 and on education/work pages.
changes.authentication: Resolve exact production/preview origins separately. Production is canonical-only. Preview trusts only its exact deployment and branch alias; APP_BASE_URL and global production hostnames no longer grant Preview origin access. Cookies remain host-only, HttpOnly, Secure on HTTPS, SameSite=Lax. Auth failures have safe messages and correlation IDs; raw auth SDK logs are replaced by structured route logs.
changes.ai: Share request validation, bounded JSON reading, consistent code/message/correlationId errors, safe provider classification, 40-second provider and 55-second client deadlines, synchronous duplicate-click guards and explicit user retry. Keep the existing success result and string error fields. No automatic provider POST retry, model migration or billing change.
changes.frontend: Use inline Japanese error notices, keep previous text on failure, preserve interview inputs, report storage failures without clearing localStorage, guard malformed stored JSON, and avoid a late initial GET overwriting edits.
changes.observability: Remove prompt/experience/strengths/keywords logs and raw exception output from all three AI routes. Record timestamp, correlationId, route, method, HTTP status, durationMs, safe code, stage, upstreamStatus when available, environment. A bounded, same-origin, fixed-schema collector separates untrusted client reports from authoritative API events.

validation.browserTool: External Playwright QA installation; no application dependency or lockfile changes.
validation.applicationRecordHandling: Browser tests intercept all resume/education/work reads and writes with synthetic fixtures. Successful auth/session/password/cookie tests use Better Auth memoryAdapter; live origin probes use a nonexistent synthetic account.

productionSettingsAfterApproval.action: Update after approval. Existing shared Preview/Production entry must be split so Preview is not implicitly changed. This also corrects CRM links in notification emails.
Not required by this implementation; exact VERCEL_URL and VERCEL_BRANCH_URL supply allowed Preview origins.
No change required by current successful generation checks.

operationalRunbook: Ask the affected user for the on-screen correlation ID and approximate JST time; never ask them to paste interview text, cookies or API keys.
In Vercel Logs, select the intended environment/deployment, then search the exact correlation ID. Inspect code, stage, status, upstreamStatus and durationMs.
CLI example: vercel logs --project carrime --scope team_iUkUC3QEpyNBJ2z1OxwMIZwh --no-branch --environment production --since 30m --query CORRELATION_ID --json --limit 20

api.completed is authoritative server execution. client.ai_failed is an untrusted browser hint. CLIENT_NETWORK_ERROR without an API event can indicate failure before API arrival or an interrupted response; it does not prove the server never executed.

Use upstreamStatus 401/403 for provider credentials/permissions, 404 for model configuration, 402/429 for quota/rate conditions, 5xx/timeouts for provider availability. Do not change models or billing solely from a generic browser alert.
Fully offline browsers cannot deliver telemetry; the on-screen ID and retained input still help manual support. Reporting is best-effort, has no background queue and never recursively retries.
Monitoring consists of correlated runtime logs and limited client reports. No external monitoring service, scheduled poll, paid log drain or notification automation is installed by this PR.
remainingWorkAfterApproval: Approve the Draft PR and the Production-only APP_BASE_URL update separately from any Preview configuration.
Merge through GitHub and wait for Vercel production readiness; do not promote a Preview deployment directly.
On the canonical production domain, confirm a real administrator login/session/logout without exposing credentials, then perform a synthetic AI smoke test and correlation lookup.

Old-origin unsent localStorage data cannot be read automatically from the new origin. Any recovery/export flow requires a separately reviewed migration mechanism. Existing server records and schemas are untouched.
